name: Unibet
verdict: Online betting and gaming brand owned by Kindred Group plc, wholly-owned by FDJ UNITED (listed on Euronext Paris; the French State held about 21% of the capital in February 2026, a passive stake). Nothing found.
note: Gambling operator. Kindred was acquired by FDJ UNITED in 2024; FDJ UNITED is a listed company whose largest shareholder is the French State (about 21%, February 2026 URD) — a passive stake, and state ownership alone is not a tier (METHOD.md). No openable source places Unibet on the 2026-27 home shirt.
